text: How does our system talk to Uzcard and Humo, when they speak different languages?
prefix: How does our system talk to Uzcard and Humo, when they speak different languages?

text: Uzcard's SV-Gate speaks JSON-RPC, and Humo speaks SOAP for payments and REST for cards, each with its own fields and codes.
prefix: Uzcard's SV-Gate speaks JSON-RPC, and Humo speaks SOAP for payments and REST for cards, each with its own fields and codes.

text: If the payment code knew both, every new scheme would mean touching payment code, and no other project could reuse the work.
prefix: If the payment code knew both, every new scheme would mean touching payment code, and no other project could reuse the work.

text: So each scheme gets its own adapter: a separate Spring Boot service with its own OpenAPI contract, that any service or project may call.
prefix: So each scheme gets its own adapter: a separate Spring Boot service with its own OpenAPI contract, that any service or project may call.

text: Every adapter answers plain REST with one envelope: a request id, the scheme's own status, and its data in the scheme's own field names.
prefix: Every adapter answers plain REST with one envelope: a request id, the scheme's own status, and its data in the scheme's own field names.

text: Inside, every scheme method is one command, picked by its type from a factory, calling the scheme through typed models and one HTTP interface client per area.
prefix: Inside, every scheme method is one command, picked by its type from a factory, calling the scheme through typed models and one HTTP interface client per area.

text: What each scheme code means lives in a status table: success, error, pending, not found, unavailable, or manual review.
prefix: What each scheme code means lives in a status table: success, error, pending, not found, unavailable, or manual review.

text: The card module turns a scheme's decline code into its own: insufficient funds, expired card, or limit exceeded.
prefix: The card module turns a scheme's decline code into its own: insufficient funds, expired card, or limit exceeded.

text: Uzcard debits in one step, by the card's token, with our payment id as the external reference.
prefix: Uzcard debits in one step, by the card's token, with our payment id as the external reference.

text: If that reference was sent before, SV-Gate refuses it as a duplicate, the adapter answers pending, and a lookup by the reference tells the outcome.
prefix: If that reference was sent before, SV-Gate refuses it as a duplicate, the adapter answers pending, and a lookup by the reference tells the outcome.

text: Humo holds the money first, and the card module captures it right away; a hold whose capture got no answer is captured when its status is asked.
prefix: Humo holds the money first, and the card module captures it right away; a hold whose capture got no answer is captured when its status is asked.

text: Humo settles a terminal's payments only after reconciliation, so the card module reconciles every Humo e POS terminal before each clearing session.
prefix: Humo settles a terminal's payments only after reconciliation, so the card module reconciles every Humo e POS terminal before each clearing session.

text: The app wires each adapter's generated clients as one HTTP service group, and the card module sees only one port, a card processor, per scheme.
prefix: The app wires each adapter's generated clients as one HTTP service group, and the card module sees only one port, a card processor, per scheme.

text: Every answer becomes one of three outcomes: approved, declined with our own code, or unknown.
prefix: Every answer becomes one of three outcomes: approved, declined with our own code, or unknown.

text: A timeout, a redirect, or an answer it cannot read is the adapter's client error, a five oh two, and the card module reads it as unknown, never a decline, because the money may already have moved.
prefix: A timeout, a redirect, or an answer it cannot read is the adapter's client error, a five oh two, and the card module reads it as unknown, never a decline, because the money may already have moved.
